lockup.summary: Directors, officers and holders of 5% or more agree not to sell for 180 days from the effective date of the prospectus. The company itself agrees not to issue or sell shares for 180 days from closing.

what: It provides staff outsourcing, executive search and human resources research services to companies in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about US$26.2 million. It plans 30% for expanding into the Asia Pacific market, 30% for using artificial intelligence to optimize resources, and 40% for general administration and working capital.
risks: Mainland China's government may step in or influence its Hong Kong operations at any time, which could sharply cut the value of the shares.
Complying with Hong Kong's personal data privacy law and similar rules may be costly and could hurt the business.
The Hong Kong National Security Law could affect its Hong Kong subsidiary, which makes up substantially all of its business.
There are political risks in doing business in Hong Kong.
It earns money in Hong Kong dollars but its shares are priced in US dollars, so currency changes may affect your investment.
